name: Saryarka – Steppe and Lakes of Northern Kazakhstan
description: Across the open grasslands of northern Kazakhstan, two nature reserves, Naurzum and Korgalzhyn, shelter lakes that act as a major crossroads for migrating birds. Millions pass through on their way between Africa, Europe, South Asia and Siberia, including Dalmatian pelicans, rare Siberian white cranes and pink flamingos. The surrounding steppe is also a refuge for the critically endangered saiga antelope.
